name: Fee-on-Transfer Token Accounting
threat_model: A vault credits the requested transfer amount even though a fee-on-transfer asset delivers less, creating claims in excess of real backing.
assumptions: The fee-token fixture reports balances honestly and charges a transfer fee.
Rebasing assets, dishonest balance reports, and tokens that debit more than requested are out of scope.
The remediated vault prices deposits using the measured balance increase and rejects unsupported fee behavior.
invariant: Credited claims equal the value actually received by the vault under the supported token model.

detector_expectations.expectation: token transfer semantics and balance-delta accounting require fixtures and executable tests
